chunks.text: We ensure that your vehicle gets the service it deserves with fully trained technicians. Our team member will carry out a comprehensive visual inspection to enable you to know in advance what to expect from your next NCT.

Kennedys garage is the registered DPF Specialist for Waterford County. A DPF IS A Diesel Particulate Filter which is fitted in your exhaust system to filter any unwanted particles entering the environment.

We are an Independent garage specialising in diagnostics . Our highly trained and motivated team are driven by the desire to find affordable and timely vehicle solutions for our customers . The team at Kennedys garage have a wealth of hands on technical knowledge from general servicing of all makes and models to diagnostics and DPF repairs . Our success has been built on consistent service, competitive pricing and excellent communication between our customers and technicians.
Experience Reliable Car Repairs and Maintenance Services

Our team has received specialist training as part of the DPF Doctor Network . This has enabled them to find the route cause of your DPF issue . This includes fault finding and also DPF cleaning where necessary.
· Identify the root cause of your DPF problem through our assessment
· Inform you of exactly what work is required.
· If required, we will perform our 3 Stage in-situ DPF clean
· Confirm the repair by analysing engine data
· Offer helpful advice about looking after your DPF
· We aim to provide a first-time fix every time.
We ensure that your vehicle gets the service it deserves with fully trained technicians.
Our team member will carry out a comprehensive visual inspection to enable you to know in advance what to expect from your next NCT.
Please contact the office for competitive pricing .
We would love to hear from you. Feel free to reach out using the contact form.
